title: Detailed bow tie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='leftWing' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff4d6d'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b3123a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='rightWing' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff4d6d'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b3123a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='knot' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff8095'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c81e45'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- left wing -->
  <path d='M48 50 L14 30 Q10 29 9 34 L9 66 Q10 71 14 70 L48 50 Z' fill='url(#leftWing)' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- left wing fold highlight -->
  <path d='M44 50 L18 35 Q16 34 16 38 L16 62 Q16 66 18 65 L44 50 Z' fill='#ff6b85' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- right wing -->
  <path d='M52 50 L86 30 Q90 29 91 34 L91 66 Q90 71 86 70 L52 50 Z' fill='url(#rightWing)' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- right wing fold highlight -->
  <path d='M56 50 L82 35 Q84 34 84 38 L84 62 Q84 66 82 65 L56 50 Z' fill='#ff6b85' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- polka dots left -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#ffe3e8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='2.6' fill='#ffe3e8'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='60' r='2.6' fill='#ffe3e8'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='41' r='2.2' fill='#ffe3e8'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='60' r='2.2' fill='#ffe3e8'/>
  <!-- polka dots right -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#ffe3e8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='2.6' fill='#ffe3e8'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='60' r='2.6' fill='#ffe3e8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='41' r='2.2' fill='#ffe3e8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='60' r='2.2' fill='#ffe3e8'/>
  <!-- knot -->
  <rect x='41' y='34' width='18' height='32' rx='6' fill='url(#knot)' stroke='#ff9db0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M45 38 Q50 36 55 38 L55 62 Q50 64 45 62 Z' fill='#ff7090' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- knot seam -->
  <line x1='50' y1='36' x2='50' y2='64' stroke='#8c0d2b' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
